_about: AUTOMATION_NEEDS_PLAN Phase 3 (C4) / AI_ASSIST_PLAN Phase 0: synthetic barangay SMS replies with the label a dispatcher would give them. Not real texts: no real names or numbers. path RULE = an exact reply code that parseBarangayReply must handle (never sent to Gemini); path AI = free text the eval sends to Gemini. expected = the label; acceptable (optional) = other labels that also count as correct for a genuinely two-way reply. Scoring: >= 90% of AI replies correct, and 0 replies whose expected label is NEEDS_BACKUP read as a calm status (SEEN, ON_THE_WAY, ON_SCENE, HANDLED). UNCLEAR is never calm: the raw text still shows. A BLOCKED call counts as wrong.
